iran_conventional.name: IRAN CONVENTIONAL

Transit remains severely constrained; diplomacy_active, hormuz_controlled_not_closed, hormuz_mining and oil_infrastructure_threat persist. Raw/coupled risk holds 95/100.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL LEBANON

This reinforces the existing ceasefire_violation while diplomacy_active continues; no new canonical signal was added
israel_lebanon.assessment: Reuters reports two Israeli soldiers killed and four wounded by an explosive device during a southern-Lebanon sweep; Israeli retaliation killed one Lebanese person and wounded 12. Existing ceasefire_violation, diplomacy_active and diplomacy_refused signals persist; raw/coupled risk holds 95/100.

turkey.assessment: Past-24h wire, NATO and regional review found no direct Türkiye combat threshold, official nuclear rhetoric or qualifying missile-range test. A draft PKK reintegration law is political context, not a configured escalation signal; risk holds 5/deterrent.

latest_news.headline: Houthi attacks kill scores in Yemen and wound 11 civilians in Saudi Arabia
latest_news.text: AFP reported 61 Yemeni government troops killed in ballistic-missile and drone attacks across Thursday-Friday, the worst losses since 2022. Saudi authorities separately said Houthi shelling in Najran wounded 11 civilians, including a four-year-old child; Yemen’s defence ministry promised a response.

latest_news.headline: Türkiye, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan sign collective-defence pact
latest_news.text: The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement says an armed attack on one signatory will be regarded as an attack on all three. Pakistan is nuclear-armed and Türkiye fields NATO’s second-largest army, but the official text describes collective deterrence and does not specify nuclear-sharing or a nuclear umbrella.

latest_news.headline: Hormuz traffic falls to eight ships as proposed framework remains incomplete
latest_news.text: Kpler counted eight ships transiting Hormuz on Thursday, down from 13 per day the prior week and more than 100 daily before the war. Iran-Oman talks remain active, but a framework would not automatically reopen the strait and shipping sources question its operational feasibility.

latest_news.headline: Saudi Arabia warns of imminent coordinated attacks from north and south
latest_news.text: A senior Saudi official told Reuters that Saudi, US and regional intelligence indicated Houthis and Iraqi militias under IRGC supervision could target energy infrastructure, ports and airports; Riyadh said contacts and mediation were still moving in the right direction.

latest_news.headline: Lebanese soldier lightly injured by Israeli drone sound bomb after talks
latest_news.text: Lebanon’s army said an Israeli drone dropped a sound bomb on an army bulldozer clearing roads in Mansouri, lightly injuring a soldier. The incident followed the seventh round of US-brokered implementation talks on Thursday.

latest_news.headline: Iraq keeps forces on high alert after militia retaliation deadline
latest_news.text: Iraq raised readiness nationwide and reported exercises and troop movements as a militia retaliation deadline expired. Badr leader Hadi al-Ameri urged factions to postpone action, but disarmament resistance and regional strike warnings persist.
sources: Iraq Security Media Cell via The National

latest_news.headline: UNIFIL records sharpest Israel-Lebanon escalation since June framework
latest_news.text: UNIFIL recorded 113 Israeli projectiles on Aug. 5 and 120 more by late Aug. 6, plus airspace violations and strikes near Al Mansuri; it reported no Hezbollah launches during the same Aug. 5 period.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine’s deep strikes keep pressure on Russian logistics networks
latest_news.text: Reuters documented repeated Ukrainian drone attacks on Wildberries-linked warehouses inside Russia, while Russian missile and drone attacks on Ukraine continued. The war tracker remains capped; no direct NATO-Russia exchange was confirmed.

latest_news.headline: Seoul policy split underscores stalled North Korea engagement
latest_news.text: South Korea’s foreign and unification ministers publicly diverged over engagement strategy. The disagreement does not alter the existing missile_range_test signal from North Korea’s Aug. 6 short-range ballistic launch; no nuclear test or ICBM launch was reported.

latest_news.headline: Six wounded in suspected IED attack near Kenya-Somalia border
latest_news.text: Shabelle Media reported that a vehicle struck a suspected roadside bomb near El Wak in Mandera County, wounding six people, one critically. Kenyan police had not attributed responsibility; the report remains a watch item pending independent corroboration.

dashboard_trackers.notes: Critical Threats Project reported on Aug. 6 that the Congolese government announced an agreement with the FDLR for voluntary disarmament and demobilization, a concrete implementation step linked to the Washington peace process. The same analysis warns Kinshasa is still deepening collaboration with the group, so this is fragile process evidence rather than conflict resolution. The canonical diplomacy_active signal activates and raw/coupled risk eases 56→53, remaining imminent

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Raw risk rises 80→85 after the deadliest Houthi attacks on Yemeni government forces since 2022: AFP reported 61 troops killed across Thursday-Friday, while Saudi authorities said cross-border shelling wounded 11 civilians in Najran. Riyadh separately warned of imminent coordinated Houthi/Iraqi-militia attacks on energy, port and airport targets. Existing ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike signals remain active; no new signal name was added
